rationale: The dev's diff already adds two comprehensive E2E specs (dashboard-exemplars.spec.js, metrics-explorer-exemplars.spec.js) plus a self-ingesting fixture module, covering every headline flow and 7 of the 10 edge cases (empty, 500+retry, not_available, line-vs-value placement, cross-query dedupe, explorer abort, light/dark contrast). Three WIRED edge cases are still uncovered and must be appended as new test() cases to the existing dashboard-exemplars.spec.js: (1) the 'none' state (exemplar with no trace_id -> 'No trace_id on this exemplar'), (2) the 'unverified' verdict (trace lookup 403/timeout/partial -> open-trace-unverified button with data-reason), and (3) a positively clamped marker + clamped-note (only the null-clamped assertion exists today). Both spec files are brand-new in the diff but are NOT registered in tests/ui-testing/ci-matrix/ci_matrix.json, so registration is still required despite action=append: add dashboard-exemplars.spec.js to the Dashboards-Charts shard run_files and metrics-explorer-exemplars.spec.js to the Metrics shard run_files. The secondary metrics-explorer surface is already fully covered by its own spec and needs only registration, not new tests.
